items.t: Phinia agrees to acquire assets of brake components maker FMP Group
items.sum: The transaction encompasses operating assets located across Australia, Thailand, and Malaysia.

items.t: PHINIA to Acquire the Business of the FMP Group with Operations in Australia, Thailand and Malaysia, a Leading Asia-Pacific Aftermarket Company
items.sum: AUBURN HILLS, Mich., November 25, 2026--PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, precision machined components and aftermarket solutions, today announced it has entered into a definitive asset purchase agreement to acquire the core operating business assets, brand rights, and capabilities of the FMP Group
